body:
Can rebuilding after historical resets restore correct-revision compiled code without per-task repairs? Follow-up to #28.

**Findings:** Original evidence confirms extension removal in seven paired validations. Both upstream native validation and exported verification omit rebuilding. An opt-in research candidate now wires recorded bootstrap commands into both paths; 12 synthetic compiled-library checks pass, including stale-binary false positives and failed-rebuild guards. Seven additional checks through the unchanged standalone graded verifier pass, including nop reward 0, oracle reward 1, and setup/build failures clearing stale rewards.

**Limitations:** These are local synthetic checks, not biological PR recovery. Full upstream configuration/CLI execution and a live MACS comparison remain untested. The saved MACS Dockerfile contains three syntactically invalid RUN commands, its smoke/fresh checks were false, and recorded rebuild commands contain unquoted version constraints. No recipe has been manually repaired.

**Next:** verify full native/configuration integration, then compare a frozen original MACS case if a faithful baseline can be reconstructed within scope. Preserve original evidence and default behavior; no additional LLM repair loop or per-PR fixes. Zero model calls and no remote jobs in this follow-up; no change promoted to main.

[Candidate lifecycle checks](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4436eaba74ec5e5ab2a85aa1430ba9a95402ae34/experiments/31-historical-builds/candidate-lifecycle-results.json) · [Graded export checks](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4436eaba74ec5e5ab2a85aa1430ba9a95402ae34/experiments/31-historical-builds/graded-export-results.json) · [Static checks and limits](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4436eaba74ec5e5ab2a85aa1430ba9a95402ae34/experiments/31-historical-builds/candidate-static-results.json) · [Full scope](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4436eaba74ec5e5ab2a85aa1430ba9a95402ae34/experiments/31-historical-builds/issue-scope.md). Detailed investigation updates remain in comments.

🤖 Initial investigation is published on the permanent research branch at `0d9d4101de445f86f438ebb7182ab0463b9fd101`. Verified original MACS evidence independently confirms extension removal in seven paired validations. An additional prerequisite emerged: three RUN commands in its saved reconstruction Dockerfile fail shell syntax checks. The original saved image cannot be assumed reproducible by building that recipe verbatim. The saved Dockerfile replays failed transcript attempts, including trailing `

` text. Four saved rebuild commands are a separate potential procedure; unquoted `numpy>=1.25` and `Cython>=3.0` are shell redirections, not protected version constraints. Syntax-only checks do not execute recipes. A native-only rebuild would also leave emitted image/verifier lifecycle gaps, so complete oracle validation remains required. Next: separate baseline reconstruction from historical rebuilding, then test correct-revision compilation at native and emitted-task boundaries before a MACS comparison. Saved rebuild commands exist but include shell-semantic hazards; no command or dependency repair has been applied. [Evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0d9d4101de445f86f438ebb7182ab0463b9fd101/experiments/31-historical-builds/findings.md) · [Scope](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0d9d4101de445f86f438ebb7182ab0463b9fd101/experiments/31-historical-builds/issue-scope.md) · [Logbook](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0d9d4101de445f86f438ebb7182ab0463b9fd101/experiments/31-historical-builds/logbook.md). All changes remain research-only; no promotion to main, live task repair or model spend. The issue remains open.

🤖 Twelve compiled-fixture cases now pass through the pinned native-stage and exported-verifier shell builders.

The original reset/clean removes the shared library. Running a deterministic compiler command after the source patch restores the intended revision: nop imports value 1 and fails; oracle imports value 2 and passes. A negative control that preserves fixed-ref compiled bytes makes the unfixed nop pass incorrectly. A separate failure control confirms that a multiline rebuild beginning with `false` stops verification before tests.

This uses synthetic C source, local path remapping and a research adapter, not a repaired biological environment. It does not yet cover integrated pipeline configuration, reset/patch failure guards, the graded-parser path or MACS recovery. The saved MACS reconstruction problems remain a separate prerequisite.

The final run took under one second, peaked below 25 MiB RSS and removed its owned temporary directory. No model calls, remote jobs or new capacity.

[Exact results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/397b7769c362c689a0714a5d1f014a6830b72cb9/experiments/31-historical-builds/compiled-lifecycle-results.json), [harness](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/397b7769c362c689a0714a5d1f014a6830b72cb9/experiments/31-historical-builds/check_compiled_lifecycle.py), [resource record](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/397b7769c362c689a0714a5d1f014a6830b72cb9/experiments/31-historical-builds/compiled-lifecycle-resources.txt), [findings and next steps](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/397b7769c362c689a0714a5d1f014a6830b72cb9/experiments/31-historical-builds/findings.md).

🤖 The opt-in rebuild candidate now covers native validation and exported verification, with default-off behavior checked against the pinned builders. All 12 synthetic compiled-library lifecycle checks and seven graded-export checks pass.

The graded checks use the unchanged upstream standalone verifier: nop earns 0 and oracle earns 1; failed builds, invalid base revisions and obstructed test resets clear stale rewards and fail closed. A command failure can still coexist with tracked-test reward 1, explicitly preserving upstream's distinction between `resolved` and `command_resolved`.

[Lifecycle evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4436eaba74ec5e5ab2a85aa1430ba9a95402ae34/experiments/31-historical-builds/candidate-lifecycle-results.json), [graded verification evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4436eaba74ec5e5ab2a85aa1430ba9a95402ae34/experiments/31-historical-builds/graded-export-results.json), and [candidate/static evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4436eaba74ec5e5ab2a85aa1430ba9a95402ae34/experiments/31-historical-builds/candidate-static-results.json).

These checks do not establish full CLI/configuration integration or MACS recovery. No Docker/Harbor execution, model calls, manual dependency repair or promotion to main occurred. The issue remains open.
